item.title: Church Point Road closed after hit-and-run crash in Gonzales leaves powerlines across roadway
item.description: GONZALES &mdash; Church Point Road in Gonzales is currently closed after a hit-and-run crash caused power lines to fall on the roadway.According to the Ascension Parish Sheriff's Office, a white Chevy pickup truck with heavy front-end damage involved in the crash was last seen traveling toward Highway 431.&nbsp;The crash caused a utility pole to snap in half, leaving power lines across the roadway. item.title: Home along South Burgess Drive catches fire Sunday
item.description: BATON ROUGE - A home along South Burgess Drive caught fire on Sunday morning, and firefighters are still determining what sparked it.&nbsp;The Baton Rouge Fire Department said a neighbor saw smoke coming from the home's roof and called 911 around 11:15 a.m.&nbsp;No one was home when the fire started, and three dogs inside the house escaped outside.Firefighters said the flames burned through part of the roof, damaging the second floor and attic.&nbsp;BRFD said foul play is not suspected.&nbsp;Per

item.title: St. George invites citizens to Stakeholder Dialogue for the St. George Comprehensive Plan 2050
item.description: ST. GEORGE &mdash; The City of St. George invited citizens to participate in the second Stakeholder Dialogue for the St. George Comprehensive Plan 2050 on Sunday.The plan will help city leaders, developers, business owners and residents make coordinated decisions about land use, housing, transportation, parks and infrastructure over the next 25 years.&nbsp;The process includes four phases of public engagement, offering residents the opportunity to share ideas on shaping the community's future.&n

item.title: Livingston Parish bridge project delayed, opening set for next month
item.description: DENHAM SPRINGS - Livingston Parish President Randy Delatte announced Sunday the Burgess Road Bridge will be opening later than expected.&nbsp;The bridge was scheduled to open Wednesday, March 11, but will now be available for use on April 20.&nbsp;Delatte said the change was due to weather impacts, contractor changes and the closure of the Lockhart Road Bridge.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments
